title: Entrance Exams
description: Major active national entrance/competitive exams plus Telangana and Andhra Pradesh state-level entrance exams.
scope_note: Currently-active exams only; discontinued/superseded exams excluded and documented in the collection report.

provenance.collection_method: WebSearch-based knowledge engineering research. Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains remained blocked by this session's organizational egress policy during RC2 as well (re-confirmed HTTP 403). All facts are cited search results; none fabricated.
provenance.confidence_calibration_note: RC2 raised confidence modestly (max +10/row for universities, +8/row for boards/exams/scholarships) where stronger multi-source corroboration was found, capped at 82 (universities) / 88 (others) — still below the 85-95 'direct official source' band, since WebFetch access was not restored.
